title: Morph selection fixed
script:
-- Make sure Fluent, SaveManager, InterfaceManager are already loaded

-- Table of fan-made morphs
local morphList = {
    ["Tails"] = "Tails",
    ["Knuckles"] = "Knuckles",
    ["Eggman"] = "Eggman",
    ["Amy"] = "Amy",
    ["Cream"] = "Cream",
    ["Sally"] = "Sally",
    ["Shadow"] = "Shadow",
    ["Rouge"] = "Rouge",
    ["Metal Sonic"] = "MetalSonic",
    ["Silver"] = "Silver",
    ["Blaze"] = "Blaze",
    ["Vector"] = "Vector",
    ["Espio"] = "Espio",
    ["Charmy"] = "Charmy",
    ["Sonic.EXE"] = "SonicEXE",
    ["Kolossos"] = "Kolossos",
    ["Tails Doll"] = "TailsDoll",
    ["Furnace"] = "Furnace"
}

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

-- Add a section inside the Main tab
local MainSection = Tabs.Main:AddSection({
    Title = "Morph Hub"
})

-- Create buttons for each morph
for displayName, modelName in pairs(morphList) do
    MainSection:AddButton({
        Text = displayName,
        Callback = function()
            local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

            -- Remove old morph
            for _, child in pairs(character:GetChildren()) do
                if child:IsA("Model") and child.Name == "CurrentMorph" then
                    child:Destroy()
                end
            end

            -- Clone new morph from ReplicatedStorage
            local morphModel = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(modelName)
            if morphModel then
                local newMorph = morphModel:Clone()
                newMorph.Name = "CurrentMorph"
                newMorph.Parent = character
                if character.PrimaryPart and newMorph.PrimaryPart then
                    newMorph:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(character.PrimaryPart.CFrame)
                end
            else
                warn("Morph "..modelName.." not found in ReplicatedStorage")
            end
        end
    })
end
